Fact.Name: Forms 1042-S
Fact.Description: Forms 1042-S, Foreign Person's U.S. Source Income Subject to Withholding, received for the 2025 return: one item per document the withholding agent issued. A Form 1040 filer who receives one is typically a resident alien who was treated as a foreign person when paid. Unanswered or answered empty, the collection asserts no document and refuses nothing.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S document owner
Fact.Description: The person on this return who received this Form 1042-S as its RECIPIENT (box 13). An unanswered owner is Incomplete; no primary-filer default is assumed, and the document's withholding credit stays Incomplete until it is answered.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S belongs to primary filer
Fact.Description: Whether this Form 1042-S belongs to the primary filer. Completeness-first: an unanswered ../filer resolves complete-safe FALSE rather than inheriting a primary-filer default, because a document whose recipient is unassigned belongs to neither filer.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S belongs to secondary filer
Fact.Description: The secondary twin of ../belongsToPrimaryFiler, read from the owner's own isSecondaryFiler: same completeness-first shape, and complete-safe FALSE on an unanswered ../filer.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 13e recipient's U.S. TIN
Fact.Description: Box 13e, the recipient's U.S. TIN, derived from this document's own recipient: the TIN of the person ../filer names, so the primary filer's TIN on the primary filer's Form 1042-S and the spouse's on the spouse's. Nothing to ask; the ../filer answer decides it. Incomplete while ../filer is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S unique form identifier
Fact.Description: The UNIQUE FORM IDENTIFIER the withholding agent printed in the header, copied as printed. It tells this document apart from an amended one for the same payment. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S AMENDED box
Fact.Description: The AMENDED checkbox in the header. A withholding agent that corrects a form it already issued sends a new one with this box checked; copy the amended amounts, not the original ones. An unchecked box is an explicit false. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S amendment number
Fact.Description: The AMENDMENT NO. cell in the header, copied as printed; blank on an original form. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 1 income code
Fact.Description: Box 1, Income code: the two-digit code the withholding agent printed from the form's own Explanation of Codes table (for example 16, scholarship or fellowship grants; 29, deposit interest). Transcribed, not classified. For a Form 1040 filer the income code decides which line of the return the box 2 amount belongs on; that routing is not built, which is what form1042S:/knockoutForm1042SIncomeRoutingUnbuilt refuses. Unanswered it is complete-safe.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 2 gross income
Fact.Description: Box 2, Gross income, as printed. For a resident alien filing Form 1040 this is income to report on the line its income code and any treaty position direct; that routing is not built, so an entered Form 1042-S is refused by form1042S:/knockoutForm1042SIncomeRoutingUnbuilt rather than the amount being dropped. Unanswered it is complete-safe.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 3 chapter indicator
Fact.Description: Box 3, Chapter indicator: the single digit 3 or 4 the withholding agent entered, naming the withholding regime (chapter 3 or chapter 4) the payment was reported under. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 3a exemption code
Fact.Description: Box 3a, Exemption code, the two-digit code from the form's Boxes 3a and 4a legend; the form prints it when the box 3b tax rate is 00.00. Transcribed, not classified. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 3b tax rate, digits before the decimal point
Fact.Description: Box 3b, Tax rate: the two digits the form prints BEFORE its fixed decimal point (the 14 of 14.00). The printed box is two cells split by a printed decimal point, and each cell is its own writable. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 7a federal tax withheld
Fact.Description: Box 7a, Federal tax withheld, as printed. It is one of the three boxes the form combines into box 10; the Form 1040 line 25c credit reads box 10 (../writableTotalWithholdingCredit), never this box, so the other-agent and repayment adjustments are not lost. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 7b escrow procedures checkbox
Fact.Description: Box 7b, checked when the federal tax withheld was not deposited with the IRS because escrow procedures were applied. The form sends the reader to its instructions (vendored, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1042s%2D-2025.pdf); this dictionary has not yet built the recipient-side credit treatment those instructions describe, so a checked box refuses the return through form1042S:/knockoutForm1042SWithholdingCreditUnbuilt instead of crediting or dropping the box 10 amount. An unchecked box is an explicit false. Unanswered it is complete-safe.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 7c subsequent-year withholding checkbox
Fact.Description: Box 7c, checked when the withholding occurred in a subsequent year with respect to a partnership interest. Which year's return claims that withholding is an instruction question this dictionary has not yet built the answer to (the instructions are vendored, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1042s%2D-2025.pdf), so a checked box refuses the return through form1042S:/knockoutForm1042SWithholdingCreditUnbuilt. An unchecked box is an explicit false. Unanswered it is complete-safe.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 7d intermediary revised-reporting checkbox
Fact.Description: Box 7d, checked by a qualified intermediary, withholding foreign partnership or withholding foreign trust that is revising its reporting to report to a specific recipient. The Copy D field's own caption omits the article before 'specific recipient'; it is the same box and binds here. An unchecked box is an explicit false. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 8 tax withheld by other agents
Fact.Description: Box 8, Tax withheld by other agents, as printed. One of the three boxes the form combines into box 10, which is what the return credits. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 9 overwithheld tax repaid
Fact.Description: Box 9, Overwithheld tax repaid to the recipient under the adjustment procedures. The form prints this entry inside parentheses because it REDUCES the box 10 total; enter the amount shown inside the parentheses as a positive number. It is never re-combined here: box 10 is read as printed. Unanswered it is complete-safe. Feeds no federal line; stored for the state and local returns, which read it by this module-qualified path, and bound in the Form 1042-S register.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 10 total withholding credit
Fact.Description: Box 10, Total withholding credit, as printed (the form's own combination of boxes 7a, 8 and 9). This is the amount a Form 1040 filer claims: it feeds ../withholdingCreditOnThisReturn and through /form1042SWithholding the Form 1040 line 25c total, taxCalculations:/otherFormWithholding. Required when a Form 1042-S is entered: unanswered, the document's credit is Incomplete, never zero.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S box 11 tax paid by withholding agent
Fact.Description: Box 11, Tax paid by the withholding agent on amounts it did not withhold. Fact.Name: Form 1042-S withholding credit depends on instructions not yet built
Fact.Description: True when this document checks box 7b (tax not deposited, escrow procedures), checks box 7c (withholding in a subsequent year on a partnership interest), or shows box 11 tax paid by the withholding agent above zero. Each of those boxes prints "see instructions" or asks which year's credit the amount is; the Form 1042-S instructions are vendored (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1042s%2D-2025.pdf) but the recipient-side credit treatment they describe is not yet built, so the box 10 credit cannot be claimed exactly. Complete-safe false on an unanswered box.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S income cannot yet be placed on the return
Fact.Description: You entered a Form 1042-S. Income reported on it has to go on the line of Form 1040 that its income code and any treaty position direct (wages, interest, dividends, a scholarship or other income, with any treaty-exempt amount backed out on Schedule 1). On a separate return in a community property state, the income and the tax withheld on it may also have to be split with your spouse. This return cannot place that income yet, so it cannot be filed here.

Fact.Name: Form 1042-S withholding cannot yet be credited exactly
Fact.Description: A Form 1042-S you entered has box 7b or box 7c checked, or shows an amount in box 11. How much of that withholding this return may claim depends on a Form 1042-S instructions rule this dictionary has not yet built, so it cannot be filed here.
